title: An Easy-Drive 16MS/s Pipelined-SAR ADC Using Split Coarse-Fine Input-Buffer-Sampling Scheme and Fast Robust Background Inter-Stage Gain Calibration
problem: Pipelined-SAR ADCs suffer from two practical challenges: (1) large sampling capacitance for noise suppression makes the input difficult to drive at medium speeds (1–20 MS/s), requiring either high supply voltage or complex predictors; (2) energy-efficient dynamic amplifiers suffer from inter-stage gain variation under PVT conditions, requiring fast and robust background calibration.
motivation: Medium-speed, high-resolution ADCs are essential for instrumentation and audio applications; eliminating auxiliary driver circuits and fast background calibration improves integration and reliability.
method: A 16 MS/s pipelined-SAR ADC using a split coarse-fine input-buffer-sampling scheme that relaxes sampling-capacitor voltage slew requirements, enabling operation from 1.8/0.9 V dual supplies without external drivers. A fast, PVT-robust background gain-calibration technique uses offset cancellation and a metastability detector with probability control, with 2-bit input dithering to ensure convergence across varying input conditions.
key_novelty: Split coarse-fine input-buffer sampling scheme eliminating the need for external driving circuits or high supply voltage, combined with fast metastability-based background calibration robust across PVT.
contributions: Split coarse-fine input-buffer-sampling reducing input slew requirements for easy driving
Rail-to-rail (3.6 V input swing) capability with low supply voltage (1.8/0.9 V)
Fast background inter-stage gain calibration using offset cancellation and metastability detection
PVT-robust calibration with input-dither control for convergence across signal conditions
baselines: conventional pipelined-SAR ADC with large sampling capacitor
limitations: Power consumption, area, and latency details not provided in abstract; calibration convergence time not specified.
primary_theme: Easy-drive pipelined-SAR ADC with split buffer sampling and fast background calibration
